title: Python Data Types
text:
Python
Data Types



Built-in Data Types

In programming, data type is an important concept.

Variables can store data of different types, and different types can do
different things.

Python has the following data types built-in by default, in these categories:

Text Type:

str

Numeric Types:

int
,
float
,

complex

Sequence Types:

list
,
tuple
,

range

Mapping Type:

dict

Set Types:

set
,
frozenset

Boolean Type:

bool

Binary Types:

bytes
,
bytearray
,

memoryview

None Type:

NoneType
